title: One Tiny Particle Hit Earth With the Energy of a 60 mph Baseball

scenes.text: One particle from space hit Earth with a baseball's energy.
It was far smaller than an atom.
It was detected over Utah on October 15th, 1991, and nicknamed the Oh-My-God particle.
It carried about 50 joules, the energy of a baseball thrown at 60 miles an hour.
All of that was packed into one particle, travelling almost exactly at the speed of light.
Nobody knows what in the universe threw it.

description:
In 1991, a detector in Utah recorded a cosmic ray carrying about 50 joules of energy, like a baseball thrown at 60 miles an hour.
It was a single particle, smaller than an atom.
Scientists still don't know where it came from.
